title: Training Note: Mileage Usage and the Northgate Tire Center Claim Fitting Charge
content:
# Mileage usage and the claim fitting charge

The Northgate Tire Center claim fitting charge — for fitting a tire replaced under the treadwear mileage warranty — is scaled by how much of the tire's treadwear warranty mileage was used.

**Rule.** The claim fitting usage share is the miles driven from the package's installation odometer to the odometer on the claim entry, divided by the tire's treadwear warranty miles. Where the usage share is below 0.6, the claim fitting charge is the charge before this scaling multiplied by that share; where it is at least 0.6 and below 0.9, it is the charge before this scaling multiplied by one half of the sum of one and that share; where it is at least 0.9, it is the charge before this scaling in full. The charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end, and no intermediate amount is rounded on its own.

## Questions answered

**Which odometer readings are used?** The installation odometer recorded on the package and the odometer on the claim entry — the most recent treadwear claim entry recorded on the package.

**Which mileage is the share measured against?** The treadwear warranty miles recorded on the package for the tire model.

**What happens exactly at 0.6?** A share of exactly 0.6 is "at least 0.6", so the charge is multiplied by one half of the sum of one and 0.6, which is 0.8.

**What happens exactly at 0.9?** A share of exactly 0.9 is "at least 0.9", so the charge is taken in full.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: warranty 60000 miles, charge before this scaling $40.00)

| Miles driven | Usage share | Band | Multiplier | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30000 | 0.5 | below 0.6 | 0.5 | $20.00 |
| 36000 | 0.6 | 0.6 up to below 0.9 | 0.8 | $32.00 |
| 45000 | 0.75 | 0.6 up to below 0.9 | 0.875 | $35.00 |
| 54000 | 0.9 | 0.9 or more | 1 | $40.00 |
